records.lesson_subject: EAP-TTLS LDAP authentication for IKEv2 IPsec agent tunnels

records.lesson_subject: Bipartite user-workstation login anomaly detection and dynamic peer communities

records.lesson_subject: FortiSwitchOS 8.0 DNS-over-TLS and explicit resolver CA validation

records.lesson_subject: FortiOS 8.0 SD-WAN ISDB destination identity matching

records.lesson_subject: FortiAnalyzer 8.0 AI Access Visibility dashboard data lineage and evidence boundaries
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: dashboard aggregates authorized FortiGate DLP, DNS AI-category, Web Filter AI-category and Application Control Generative AI logs into threat, overview and category widgets
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiGate inspection/logging -> log transport to authorized FortiAnalyzer -> ADOM/time-filtered aggregation -> threat/overview/category widgets with sanctioned/unsanctioned labels sourced from FortiGate
records.failure_class: AI activity absent or undercounted because source logs, device authorization, category classification or time filter are missing; stale device status misread as no logs

records.remediation_path: verify FortiGate authorization, DLP/DNS/Web Filter/App Control logging and categories, ADOM/time filters and log receive counters before treating zero as no usage

records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiGate DLP/DNS/WebFilter/AppControl logs -> authorized FortiAnalyzer -> time/ADOM filter -> threats/overview/categories

records.lesson_subject: IOC rescan lifecycle: FortiGuard TIDB, historical logs, and tagged alerts

records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiGate logs -> FortiAnalyzer log store -> TIDB package -> real-time IOC or historical rescan -> tagged event handler/alert -> analyst.
records.failure_class: Missing IOC license or stale demo TIDB; service/rescan disabled; ADOM/log-type/date scope excludes the evidence; excessive scan load.

records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiGate logs + FortiGuard TIDB -> FortiAnalyzer IOC -> real-time/rescan paths -> tagged event handlers -> analyst.

records.lesson_subject: FortiOS 8.0 FortiAP radio VAP-broadcast disable without deleting SSID configuration
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: radio-level vap-status suppresses all configured SSID/VAP broadcasts while preserving per-radio SSID assignments; device override can supersede WTP profile setting
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: WTP profile radio vap-status disable -> controller pushes radio state; optional per-WTP override-vap-status enable plus local vap-status controls one AP; re-enable restores configured VAPs
records.failure_class: maintenance/test AP stops advertising but operator deletes SSID or changes VAP assignment unnecessarily; profile setting masked by device override
records.evidence_pattern: WTP profile radio vap-status and per-device override state; SSID remains assigned but is not broadcast; no beacon does not prove AP is unpowered
records.remediation_path: check profile and per-device override precedence, disable broadcast at intended scope, preserve VAP list, re-enable and verify beacons/association
records.question_fingerprint: distinguish radio VAP broadcast suppression from deleting an SSID, disabling CAPWAP or removing PoE
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: WTP profile radio status -> per-device override decision -> radio VAP broadcast on/off; SSID objects retained

records.lesson_subject: Clear Channel Assessment threshold tuning for high-density radios
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Per-radio Clear Channel Assessment carrier-sense threshold, with WTP-profile default and optional per-AP override.
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: RF energy arrives -> CCA threshold classifies channel busy/idle -> radio defers or transmits -> airtime/retry/collision behavior changes.
records.failure_class: Profile not assigned; per-AP override masks profile; threshold too low causes excess deferral; threshold too high increases collisions/hidden nodes.
records.evidence_pattern: diagnose wireless-controller wlac -c wtp; cw_diag -c radio-cfg; effective cca_threshold; noise floor/channel utilization/retries.
records.remediation_path: Verify profile and override precedence, tune per radio in small steps, compare airtime/retries/throughput, separate RF contention from CAPWAP failures.
records.question_fingerprint: Threshold sign and sensitivity; profile versus AP override; default 0; interpreting channel utilization and retries.
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Neighboring AP transmissions -> FortiAP radio CCA threshold -> defer or transmit -> client airtime/retry outcomes.

records.lesson_subject: FortiAuthenticator 6.6.7 SHA-1 cryptographic operation removal and certificate migration
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiAuthenticator removes SHA-1 cryptographic operations; certificate signing must use SHA-2 or above; compatibility boundary is algorithm support, not a generic key-size change
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: certificate or signing operation requests SHA-1 -> FAC rejects unsupported algorithm -> administrator identifies issuing profile/certificate chain and reissues with SHA-2+ -> relying parties validate new chain
records.failure_class: legacy SHA-1-signed certificate or signing workflow fails after upgrade; operator misattributes any SSO failure to SHA-1 without inspecting signature algorithm
records.evidence_pattern: certificate signature algorithm, issuer chain, FAC release and cryptographic operation logs; RSA key size alone does not reveal SHA-1 use
records.remediation_path: inventory SHA-1-signed certificates and dependent signing workflows, reissue with SHA-256 or stronger supported digest, validate chain and relying-party trust before upgrade
records.question_fingerprint: distinguish certificate public-key algorithm from signature digest and distinguish SHA-1 deprecation from unrelated NTLM signing failures
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: legacy SHA-1 certificate/profile -> FAC algorithm policy gate -> reissue SHA-2 certificate -> relying-party chain validation

records.lesson_subject: RADIUS accounting proxy: attribute transformation and RSSO fan-out
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: RADIUS accounting source registration, attribute transformation (static/LDAP/rename), filtering, and multi-destination RSSO replication.
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Carrier RADIUS Accounting-Request -> FortiAuthenticator source -> rule set/LDAP group lookup -> multiple FortiGate/FortiMail destinations -> RSSO sessions.
records.failure_class: Source or destination secret mismatch; filter drops record; username-to-LDAP mapping fails; group cache stale; destination unreachable.
records.evidence_pattern: Source/destination counters and logs; transformed attributes; FortiGate RSSO session/user-group state; proxy retry/statistics settings.
records.remediation_path: Validate source first, inspect match filters and LDAP attribute mapping, test each destination/secret, tune cache and retry parameters.
records.question_fingerprint: Accounting versus authentication; source/rule/destination object roles; LDAP-derived attributes; cache and fan-out diagnostics.
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Carrier RADIUS server -> FortiAuthenticator source -> transform/filter rule set -> multiple RSSO destinations.

records.lesson_subject: FortiOS IPsec pre- versus post-encapsulation fragmentation: GTP-U packet integrity, reassembly and throughput
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: ip-fragmentation phase1 control selects pre-encapsulation inner fragmentation versus post-encapsulation outer ESP fragmentation; post-encapsulation reassembles ESP before decrypting so downstream receives complete inner GTP-U
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: inner GTP-U packet -> IPsec encryption -> outer ESP packet; post-encapsulation fragments outer IP packet to underlay MTU -> receiver reassembles outer fragments -> decrypts ESP -> forwards complete inner GTP-U; pre-encapsulation instead ...
records.failure_class: downstream GTP-U endpoint receives inner IPv4 fragments it cannot reassemble; post-encapsulation avoids that but can expose CPU/HPE/reassembly-memory bottlenecks
records.evidence_pattern: downstream sniffer shows fragment offsets vs complete UDP/2152 datagram; tunnel phase1 ip-fragmentation mode; HPE_IPSEC_ESP/HPE_IP_FRAG counters; ReasmFails and fragment memory; tunnel interface MTU
records.remediation_path: configure post-encapsulation on both sending peers, ensure tunnel MTU fits largest inner packet, inspect HPE and fragment reassembly counters, size HPE/fragment memory safely, preferably avoid fragmentation by sizing GTP-U MTU
records.question_fingerprint: distinguish inner fragmentation before encryption from outer ESP fragmentation after encryption and distinguish packet integrity from CPU/reassembly throughput
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: inner GTP-U packet -> encrypt -> outer ESP fragment pair -> underlay -> reassemble outer ESP -> decrypt -> complete GTP-U to downstream

records.lesson_subject: IPv6 prefix delegation: IA_PD from the ISP to routed downstream segments
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: DHCPv6 IA_PD lease acquisition, IAID-based downstream interface binding, and downstream DHCPv6/SLAAC prefix distribution.
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: ISP DHCPv6 server -> FortiGate upstream IA_PD client -> delegated downstream interface -> optional DHCPv6 server/SLAAC -> child FortiGate or LAN clients.
records.failure_class: No IA_PD lease; mismatched IAID/upstream reference; downstream RA/DHCPv6 service absent; delegated DNS not propagated.
records.evidence_pattern: Upstream get output with delegated-prefix IAID/lifetimes/DNS; downstream ip6-mode delegated and ip6-address; diagnose ipv6 address list; DNS proxy state.
records.remediation_path: Verify provider IA_PD, prefix hint, IAID consistency, downstream interface mode/upstream binding, DHCPv6 server or SLAAC, and delegated DNS independently.
records.question_fingerprint: IA_PD lease versus downstream binding; IAID consistency; client DNS propagation; prefix hint versus installed prefix.
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: ISP DHCPv6 server -> core FortiGate upstream IA_PD -> delegated downstream port -> branch FortiGate DHCPv6 client -> LAN.

records.lesson_subject: FortiManager 8.0 recurring policy-package installation scheduling
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: time-based recurring install schedule attached to policy package and selected managed devices; daily/weekly/monthly cadence with start date/time and end date
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Policy & Objects package -> Install Wizard -> Install Policy Package & Device Settings -> Schedule Install -> choose recurrence/window -> select target devices -> scheduler creates future install tasks
records.failure_class: schedule exists but target list, package state, connectivity or validation prevents intended deployment; change is deployed outside window if operators bypass scheduler

records.question_fingerprint: distinguish schedule definition from execution result and one-time versus recurring cadence
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: policy package changes -> recurring schedule -> time trigger -> selected managed FortiGate devices -> per-device install task/results

records.lesson_subject: Protected object permissions: controlled editing without breaking policy reuse
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Global object-protection visibility plus admin-profile Protected Objects authorization and per-policy/per-object protected state.
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Privileged administrator enables global/profile permission and marks item protected -> consumer administrator references item but cannot edit/save it.
records.failure_class: Protected toggle absent; consumer unexpectedly edits item; protected item cannot be selected due unrelated ADOM/object permission.
records.evidence_pattern: gui-object-protect global setting; assigned admin profile protected-objects value; Protected column; two-account edit/reference test.
records.remediation_path: Enable global visibility, assign correct profile, mark each policy/object protected, verify with owner and consumer accounts.
records.question_fingerprint: Global versus profile enablement; reference-versus-edit distinction; ADOM/workspace boundary; owner/consumer verification.

records.lesson_subject: FortiNAC 9.4 dashboard widgets as host-activity, logical-network and RADIUS evidence
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Recent Hosts, Top Host Activity, Logical Network Access and RADIUS widgets expose discovery, connection activity, network access and authentication success/failure over configurable windows
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: host discovery and connection events plus logical-network assignment and RADIUS outcomes -> FortiNAC activity data -> dashboard widget time-window aggregation -> drill-down triage
records.failure_class: operator confuses host presence/activity with successful authorization or assumes RADIUS success proves correct logical-network access

records.question_fingerprint: choose the widget that answers discovery versus activity versus logical-network access versus authentication result
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: host discovery/connection/RADIUS/logical-network events -> FortiNAC data -> four dashboard widgets -> drill-down host investigation

records.lesson_subject: Device profiling rules: ordered rogue evaluation and host lifecycle

records.remediation_path: Rank low-cost methods first, repair L3/DHCP/SNMP evidence, distinguish Fail from Cannot Evaluate, and re-register eligible hosts before reclassification.
records.question_fingerprint: Pass/Fail/Cannot Evaluate; queue semantics; host versus inventory placement; re-evaluation limits.
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Unknown endpoint -> rogue record/IP mapping -> ranked rules -> pass/fail/cannot-evaluate -> Host View/Inventory/manual review.

records.lesson_subject: FortiNAC-F maximum concurrent sessions with accounting-backed Registered Host and Logged in Host limits
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: global and per-user session caps distinguish Registered Host from Logged in Host; supported authentication methods depend on accounting/logout behavior; per-user overrides global and no group-level setting exists
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: RADIUS/agent/VPN/captive portal session event -> accounting start/stop updates active host/session state -> global or per-user limit check -> allow or reject additional concurrent host
records.failure_class: stale or missing accounting records cause incorrect session counts; Disconnect-NAK leaves a client in prior session/VLAN and may delay session cleanup
records.evidence_pattern: accounting enabled, Registered Host/Logged in Host counts, user-level override, RADIUS start/stop and Disconnect-Request/NAK; a disconnect request sent does not prove the NAS ended the session
records.remediation_path: enable accounting on the relevant access device, verify supported auth method, correlate start/stop and disconnect responses, correct custom RFC5176 attributes where NAS rejects disconnect
records.question_fingerprint: distinguish registered endpoints from active logged-in sessions and identify when missing accounting skews a limit
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: endpoint authentication -> NAS/RADIUS accounting -> FortiNAC session table -> global/user limit evaluation -> access decision

records.lesson_subject: Network-device discovery with SNMP and recursive CDP expansion

records.lesson_subject: FortiPAM 1.9 auto-purging inactive auto-provisioned users (disable then delete)

records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: external provisioning creates user -> inactivity timer expires -> account disabled and system event logged/license seat freed -> disabled timer expires -> account deleted
records.failure_class: stale accounts consume seats or are deleted unexpectedly; manual users incorrectly assumed to be in auto-provisioned cleanup scope

records.question_fingerprint: distinguish disable threshold from purge threshold and auto-provisioned from manually created users
records.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: auto-provisioned user -> inactivity timer -> disabled/license release -> disabled retention timer -> purge

records.lesson_subject: Remote user groups: LDAP, RADIUS, and SAML membership projection
records.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Remote FortiPAM user groups map LDAP/RADIUS/SAML remote membership into local groups with separate group-object permissions.
records.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: Remote identity server -> LDAP filter or RADIUS/SAML group match -> FortiPAM Remote user group -> membership -> separate resource/secret authorization.
records.failure_class: Remote server unavailable; LDAP filter/group DN mismatch; RADIUS/SAML group-name mismatch; confusing group Owner/Viewer with secret permission.
